en: Sepia-toned postcard illustration of a serene lakeside or river scene in a landscaped park. On the left stands a villa-like building with a cylindrical tower and conical roof, surrounded by lush gardens and palm-like plants. A wide tree dominates the center, its branches hanging over the water. In the foreground a small rowboat with a man rowing and a woman in a large hat glides on the calm water, while several other boats are moored along the bank and another small boat is visible in the distance. A path with a simple wooden railing runs along the shore, and tall trees line the opposite bank.
